_note: SYNTHETIC teaching advisories in a simplified shape. They are not real vulnerability records. They exist so that the capstone can practise the mechanism of a dependency scan offline: a lock file is compared with a list of affected ranges. With network access, use a real scanner (for example pip-audit, or an OSV-based scanner) on the same lock file.
